title: Antique Bakery
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Keiichiro Tachibana quits a corporate job to open a small Tokyo patisserie, hiring Ono, a gifted gay pastry chef he once rejected in high school, and Eiji, a former boxer who becomes Ono's apprentice. Episodes follow the staff and customers, while Tachibana's motive ties back to his kidnapping as a child; a new wave of child kidnappings returns in the last volume.
life_message: A good life is honest craft, shared work and slowly facing old wounds with people who accept you.
